newsitem.title: UK: UK wool sale sees firm prices, Supers settle highe.
newsitem.headline: UK wool sale sees firm prices, Supers settle highe.

text.p: The 19th sale of the UK selling season saw a generally steady market for raw wool, the British Wool Marketing Board said.
Picks and Supers edged five percent higher since the last Bradford sale on February 26 while Radnors sold in sellers favour.
All other types were firm, the Board reported.
The total offering of 2,378,993 kgs achieved a clearance rate of ninety percent.
Further details will be available later.
